about: The learning plan (MASTER_PROMPT §8.1 levels, §8.3 rhythm, §8.4 checks; numbers checked 2026-10-13). TBCL levels 1-4 are split into N and N* sub-bands (shown as 1 / 1+; the split is inferred, not official). released_units: the units the Units page and Today offer (M5: TBCL levels 1 and 2).

checks.note_en: An end-of-level check unlocks once 90% of the level's units are done. Use the official free TOCFL mock tests at the end of each phase; the real exam is the learner's decision (mentioned once at Band A and once at Band B).

can_do_en: I can read and type every Zhuyin symbol and write tones the Taiwan way.
I can hear and say the four tones and the neutral tone in single syllables and two-syllable words.
I can tell the hardest contrasts of §6.2 apart by ear (ㄐ/ㄓ/ㄗ, ㄑ/ㄔ/ㄘ, ㄒ/ㄕ/ㄙ, ㄩ/ㄧ/ㄨ, ㄣ/ㄥ, ㄢ/ㄤ, ㄖ/ㄌ, aspiration …) and produce them.
I can apply the 3+3, 一 and 不 tone changes when I speak.

milestone.en: Pronunciation diagnostic (part of the placement check)

can_do_en: I can greet people, introduce myself and talk about my family.
I can buy things at a convenience store, a breakfast shop, a drink stand and a night market, including sugar and ice levels and prices.
I can ask and tell the time, days and dates, and make a simple plan with someone.
I can ask for directions and understand a short answer.
I can order a bento, take the train or a bus, and buy a ticket.
I can see a doctor with my 健保卡, describe simple symptoms and get medicine at a pharmacy.
I can post a parcel, use a bank or ATM, call someone or send a LINE message.
I can ask about a room to rent and follow a typhoon warning and the plans it changes.

milestone.en: Level 1 and Level 2 checks; the TOCFL 準備級 mock test at the end of the phase

can_do_en: I can order food and drinks and deal with a small problem with the order.
I can take transport, including changes and delays, and ask about times and fares.
I can see a doctor and explain how long and how badly something hurts.
I can chat with neighbours about family, work, the weather and weekend plans.

milestone.en: Level 3 check; the TOCFL Band A mock test (the real exam is mentioned once here)

can_do_en: I can handle most everyday situations in Pingtung on my own, including renting, repairs and appointments.
I can follow the main points of clear speech on familiar topics and of short news items.
I can tell a story or describe an experience, give reasons and opinions.
I can write a short message or a simple formal note.
phases.units_note_en: Level 4 units come with LEVEL-UP. Immersion mode is suggested from here (Band B).

milestone.en: Level 4 check; the TOCFL Band B mock test (the real exam is mentioned once here)

levels.note_en: B2 sits between Level 5 and Level 6

can_do_en: I can follow news, discussions and longer talks on a wide range of topics.
I can take part in discussions, explain a viewpoint and weigh up options.
I can tell written from spoken register (書面語 / 口語) and use common idioms correctly.

milestone.en: Level 5 check; the TOCFL Band B 高階級 mock test

can_do_en: I can understand demanding, longer texts and implicit meaning.
I can express myself fluently and precisely for social, work and formal purposes.

milestone.en: Level 6 and 7 checks; the TOCFL Band C mock test
